title: The seventy sent out two and two — the number of the nations, the number of Jacob's house, and the elders under Moses (Genesis 10; Deuteronomy 32; Numbers 11; Luke 10)
summary:
It ain't new. Seventy is a counted number before Luke uses it. The nations after the flood, the house of Jacob going down into Egypt, and the elders Moses gathered to the tabernacle all come to seventy, and Luke alone tells of seventy sent out:

*After these things Yahusha (Lord) appointed other seventy also, and sent them two and two before his face into every city and place, whither he himself would come.* (Luke 10:1)

Count the nations first:

*These are the families of the sons of Noah, after their generations, in their nations: and by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood.* (Genesis 10:32)

The families listed in that chapter come to seventy. Then count the house that went down into Egypt:

*And the sons of Joseph, which were born him in Egypt, were two souls: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten.* (Genesis 46:27)

*And all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls: for Joseph was in Egypt already.* (Exodus 1:5)

Moses sings that the two numbers were set against each other on purpose, when the nations were divided after Babel:

*When the El Elyon (most High) divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel).* (Deuteronomy 32:8)

*For the LORD’S portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.* (Deuteronomy 32:9)

The oldest Hebrew copies of that verse read *sons of Elohim (God)* where the later copies read *children of Yashar'el (Israel)*; either way the bounds of the nations were set by a number, the number is Jacob's, and Jacob himself is the portion kept back. The nations went under other princes at the dividing, and scripture does not hide it:

*I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the El Elyon (most High).* (Psalm 82:6)

*But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.* (Psalm 82:7)

*Arise, O Elohim (God), judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.* (Psalm 82:8)

In the wilderness the number of the house repeats in its elders:

*And Yahuah (LORD) said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel), whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.* (Numbers 11:16)

So when Yahusha (Jesus) sends seventy before his face, it is the house numbered as it was numbered going into Egypt and under Moses, sent out into the cities the nations were given at the dividing, with the charge the twelve had:

*And heal the sick that are therein, and say unto them, The kingdom of Elohim (God) is come nigh unto you.* (Luke 10:9)

*Even the very dust of your city, which cleaveth on us, we do wipe off against you: notwithstanding be ye sure of this, that the kingdom of Elohim (God) is come nigh unto you.* (Luke 10:11)

When they come back he tells them what he saw while they went, and what they were given to do to the princes of those cities:

*And the seventy returned again with joy, saying, Adonai (Lord), even the devils are subject unto us through thy name.* (Luke 10:17)

*And he said unto them, I beheld Satan as lightning fall from heaven.* (Luke 10:18)

*Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.* (Luke 10:19)

The serpent and the seed of the woman have been at enmity since the garden, and the treading was promised there:

*And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.* (Genesis 3:15)

Then he says why the thing is hidden from some and seen by others, and it is not their cleverness:

*In that hour Yahusha (Jesus) rejoiced in spirit, and said, I thank thee, O Father, Yahuah (Lord) of heaven and earth, that thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes: even so, Father; for so it seemed good in thy sight.* (Luke 10:21)

*All things are delivered to me of my Father: and no man knoweth who the Son is, but the Father; and who the Father is, but the Son, and he to whom the Son will reveal him.* (Luke 10:22)

The Father hides and the Son reveals. The seventy go out as the house numbered against the nations, and in those cities the ones it was shown to hear them, and the ones it was hidden from get the dust of their own street.

6784.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) sends out seventy, and the number was counted long before. Genesis lists the families of Noah's sons, and by them *the nations divided* after the flood. Those families come to seventy. The seventy he sends are numbered against the nations they are sent into.
6784.phrase: by these were the nations divided in the earth after the flood
6784.sentence: The nations divided after the flood came to seventy families, and that is the count the seventy sent out are set against.

6782.prose: Seventy again, this time the house of Jacob going down. The two sons born to Joseph in Egypt bring the count to *threescore and ten*, and that is the whole house that came in. The seventy Yahusha (Jesus) sends is the house's number, set beside the number of the nations.
6782.phrase: all the souls of the house of Jacob, which came into Egypt, were threescore and ten
6782.sentence: The house of Jacob went into Egypt at seventy, so the seventy sent out carry the number of the house.

6781.prose: The count is told a second time and the number does not move. Every soul that came out of Jacob's loins was *seventy souls*, and Joseph was in Egypt already. The seventy sent before the face of Yahusha (Jesus) stand beside the house as it was numbered going down.
6781.phrase: all the souls that came out of the loins of Jacob were seventy souls
6781.sentence: Exodus gives the same number for the house of Jacob, confirming the seventy that the nations' seventy are set against.

6780.prose: Moses is told to gather seventy of the elders and bring them to the tabernacle to stand with him. The number comes up a third time, now in the elders of the house. When Yahusha (Jesus) sends seventy before his face, it is that house numbered again, as it was in Egypt and in the wilderness.
6780.phrase: Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Yashar'el (Israel)
6780.sentence: The seventy elders of Yashar'el (Israel) gathered under Moses are the house's number repeating, the number Luke's seventy carry.

6783.prose: Moses sings that when the nations were divided, the bounds were set *according to the number* of a people. The oldest Hebrew copies read sons of Elohim (God) where the later copies read children of Yashar'el (Israel). Either way a number set the bounds, and Yahusha (Jesus) sends seventy, the house's number, into the cities of the nations.
6783.phrase: he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Yashar'el (Israel)
6783.sentence: The bounds of the nations were set by a number, and the seventy sent out are that number going into those bounds.

6779.prose: The seventy are given the word the twelve were given. The twelve preached that the kingdom was *at hand*, and the seventy say it has *come nigh unto you*. Same charge, same sick to heal, handed on to a second company sent out before Yahusha (Jesus).
6779.phrase: And as ye go, preach, saying, The kingdom of heaven is at hand
6779.sentence: The twelve went out preaching that the kingdom was at hand, and the seventy go out with the same word.

6778.prose: Both companies are told what to do where they are not heard. The twelve are to *shake off the dust of your feet*, and the seventy wipe off the very dust of the city. They do not chase anyone. They say the kingdom of Elohim (God) has come near, and they go on.
6778.phrase: when ye depart out of that house or city, shake off the dust of your feet
6778.sentence: Those who will not receive the word get the dust shaken off, the same answer the twelve were given.

6777.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) says he beheld Satan fall like lightning from heaven. Revelation tells in its own words of the dragon, *that old serpent*, cast out into the earth with his angels. Set side by side, both speak of Satan brought down from heaven, and the seventy come back saying devils obey them.
6777.phrase: the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan
6777.sentence: Revelation names the dragon as that old serpent called the Devil and Satan, cast out into the earth with his angels.

6776.prose: The treading was promised in the garden. A serpent and a seed were set at enmity there, and the seed was to bruise the serpent's head. Now Yahusha (Jesus) gives the seventy power to tread on serpents and over *all the power of the enemy*, and that promise is what they walk out on.
6776.phrase: it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel
6776.sentence: The serpent's head is to be bruised by the woman's seed, and the seventy are handed the treading that promise looked toward.

6775.prose: Yahusha (Jesus) gives the same thanks in Matthew and in Luke, and each time the Father hid and the Father revealed. The things are hid from *the wise and prudent* and shown to *babes*, so hearing is not a matter of cleverness. After the seventy return, those who hear them are the ones it was shown to.
6775.phrase: thou hast hid these things from the wise and prudent, and hast revealed them unto babes
6775.sentence: The Father hides these things from the wise and shows them to babes, which is why some hear the seventy and some do not.

6774.prose: The Son reveals the Father to whom he will, and here he says it from the shepherd's side. He knows his sheep and is *known of mine*. Those he shows himself to are his own sheep. In the cities the seventy enter, the ones it was shown to hear them, and the rest get the dust of their street.
6774.phrase: I am the good shepherd, and know my sheep, and am known of mine
6774.sentence: The shepherd knows his sheep and is known by them, which is the same showing and hearing the Son speaks of.
